mechanism_review.scope: out-of-existing-power-coverage ATC+N0 WFS/RAD/HOA, using LB+N0 as internal in-coverage comparator

decisions.reason: The out-of-coverage ATC+N0 carrier preserves the same residual readback and through-focus mechanism direction as the in-coverage LB+N0 comparator. At EPD3, delta DOF50 is +0.162255 D in ATC and +0.194123 D in LB, with distance-peak shift 0 D in both. Residual-induced EPD3 wavefront signatures are nearly identical (delta C4 about +0.03303 um; delta C6 about -0.01617 um).

The ATC+N0 actual-eye diagnostic piston (-0.042042 um) is continuous with both LB+N0 and the historical TASK-007 RAD pattern, while standard-eye low-order and MONO/EDOF ray-health gates pass. At EPD3, delta DOF50 is +0.233807 D in ATC and +0.189130 D in LB, with 0 D distance-peak shift in both and closely matched residual-induced C4/C6 signatures.

The intended opposite-sign spherical-aberration mechanism is preserved below the historical power envelope. At EPD3, ATC delta C4=-0.071860 um and delta C6=+0.178767 um; LB delta C4=-0.071889 um and delta C6=+0.178813 um. Delta DOF50 is +0.716315 D in ATC and +0.735615 D in LB, with the same -0.25 D distance-peak shift.

scientific_caveats: Both HOA EDOF EPD5 configurations place the distance peak at the -0.50 D boundary of the frozen distance-peak search window, so the exact peak location is censored and may lie at a more negative defocus.
In untreated N0 at EPD5, delta DOF50 is negative for WFS, RAD, and HOA in both base eyes. This is retained as pupil-dependent mechanism behavior, not treated as residual failure or optimized away.

TASK-007 calibration and TASK-013 production use different study contexts/analysis routes; mechanism direction and wavefront signature may be compared, but absolute DOF50 or peak-shift values are not asserted to be numerically identical.
